topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: I can't believe this is happening. After all the planning, all the effort to get everything just right, it's all unraveling because of a single delayed flight. I was supposed to be there, to see it all unfold in person, not stuck here with nothing but the sound of my frustration echoing in this airport. Now I have to tell them I won't make it. Great. Just when it mattered most. I wonder if they'll even understand, or if I'll just be seen as another absent figure. Perfect. Just what I needed.
